derivedFrom.title: Race Steering wheel - Lamborghini Essenza SCV12
derivedFrom.author: SDC PERFORMANCE

wheels.notes: Converted from the .blend source to glTF (Blender), modifiers applied and parts joined, scaled to 0.32 m wide, centred and turned to face +Z, textures reduced to 2048 px. The gauge graphic is painted black so the app's dashboard draws on a dark screen; the screen fit ships in the file.

wheels.name: Logitech G29
wheels.author: TAA36598SansD
wheels.source: Sketchfab model, the wheel only, converted and fitted for the app
wheels.notes: The wheel only: the base, the pedal set and a stray part are left out (the app turns the whole model). SketchUp's back-face copies removed, one-sided faces turned outwards, the rim's 24° tilt taken out so it faces +Z, scaled to 0.27 m across and centred on the hub. Colours set to the real wheel's finish (black leather rim, brushed metal spokes); the source has no textures.

wheels.name: Racing Steering Wheel
wheels.author: Robert Prispilović
wheels.source: Sketchfab model, converted for the app
wheels.notes: Converted from the FBX source to glTF with the app's importer, ambient occlusion multiplied into the base colour, roughness and metallic maps reduced to their averages; scaled to 0.35 m wide, centred and turned to face +Z.
